title: Good Sizes!
text: Good Sizes!. We use storage space saver bags all the time. They're great for bedding! These are good, but not perfect. The sizes are good. The biggest ones are huge! The valves on the bags have to be turned/twisted in order to open them up so you can release the air. We didn't realize that at first, but the pictures on the packaging show that you need to do that. The pump and the valve don't have any threading to them, so the pump gets separated from the valve easily. We haven't been able to get the bags as flat as we have with other bags.
